Blunav, an airport operations technology startup, raised $1 million in a seed round led by Piper Serica to expand its team and scale its Airport Operating System across India and abroad.

STCH, a Bengaluru-based textile tech startup, raised $5.5 million in a pre-Series A round led by Omnivore, with participation from Kae Capital and WVC, to expand its AI-driven fabric R&D and manufacturing platform.

summary: Figtree Pharmacy, a Mumbai-based neighbourhood pharmacy startup, raised seed funding from AJVC Fund and other investors to expand its store network and strengthen logistics and technology.
Healthcare automation startup Coral raised $12.5 million from Z47 and Lightspeed Venture Partners.
Chiratae Ventures announced its Sonic DeepTech batch, committing up to $10 million to five startups across various deeptech sectors.
Fintech startup Freo announced the acquisition of digital lending marketplace IndiaLends, gaining full ownership and planning a future capital raise.
Emami Ltd agreed to acquire a 60% stake in IncNut Digital, the parent of Vedix and SkinKraft, for Rs 321 crore, with performance-linked adjustments and future tranche purchases.
CarTrade reported Q4 FY26 revenue of over Rs 200 crore and a 54% profit increase, but no funding round was announced.
Ola Consumer (formerly Ola Cabs) reported a 42% drop in revenue to Rs 1,171 crore in FY25 and a doubling of losses, with cash reserves falling over 50%.
PB Fintech reported Q4 FY26 revenue of Rs 2,061 crore and a 54% profit increase, with no mention of a new funding round.
Paytm reported Q4 FY26 revenue of Rs 2,264 crore and profit of Rs 183 crore, achieving full-year profitability for FY26.
The Indian government announced a Rs 10,000 crore Fund of Funds 2.0 to support deep-tech, manufacturing and early-growth startups through segmented AIFs.
Masters’ Union launched a Rs 100 crore early-stage investment platform, MU Ventures, to fund{...}young founders across sectors in India.
